Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CURSOR mc_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'ATRCF'
 AND UPPER(code_desc) = :ctrl_block_1.fcn_name
 AND :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate+1);

 l_recFound BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER; 
BEGIN 
 IF :ctrl_block_1.fcn_name IS NULL THEN
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE 
 OPEN mc_cur;
 FETCH mc_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := mc_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE mc_cur;
 
 IF l_recFound THEN
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 GO_BLOCK('valid_attribute_config');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 ELSE
 show_error('0483');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MC_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION mc_check(p_codeType IN VARCHAR2, p_code IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR mc_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = p_codeType
 AND code = p_code
 AND :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate+1);
 
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_recFound BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 OPEN mc_cur;
 FETCH mc_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_recFound := mc_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE mc_cur;
 
 RETURN l_recFound;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRODDESC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_prodDesc(prdCode_IN IN VARCHAR2, prdDesc_OUT OUT VARCHAR2, recFound_OUT OUT BOOLEAN) IS
 CURSOR vpt_cur IS
 SELECT product_type_desc
 FROM valid_product_types
 WHERE product_type_code = prdCode_IN
 AND :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate+1);
BEGIN
 OPEN vpt_cur;
 FETCH vpt_cur INTO prdDesc_OUT;
 recFound_OUT := vpt_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE vpt_cur;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPARISON
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
Function COMPARISON (val1 varchar2, val2 varchar2)
Return number
Is
 answer number := 0;
Begin
 if val1 = val2 then
 answer := 1;
 end if;
 return(answer);
End;
